messages.subject: JOB: Research Studentships in Statistics
parts:
With apologies for cross-posting. Please note that the closing date
for receipt of applications is June 30.


University of Kent at Canterbury

Four Research Studentships in Statistics

Four externally funded research studentships (including two
CASE studentships) are available at the Institute of
Mathematics and Statistics at the University of Kent. They are
as follows :

==================================================
(i) EPSRC CASE award with Pfizer Central Research : Bayesian
analysis of genomic microarray data; supervised by Phil Brown,
with co-supervision from Pfizer at Sandwich, Kent.

(ii) BBSRC studentship : Mathematical modelling of
physiological responses mediated by voltage dependent
calcium-permeable ion channels; supervised by Martin Ridout
and Byron Morgan, and involving collaboration with
Horticulture Research International, Wellesbourne, near
Warwick.

(iii) EPSRC project studentship : Stochastic modelling of
wildlife populations; supervised by Byron Morgan. This project
dovetails with an EPSRC post-doc position, supervised by Steve
Brooks in Cambridge.

(iv) EPSRC CASE award with Astrozeneca : Statistical issues in
avian toxicology and avian risk assessment; supervised by
Peter Chapman, Astrozeneca, and Byron Morgan.
==================================================

Applications are invited from suitably qualified and
interested individuals with a relevant UK connection
(see EPSRC eligibility requirements). The closing date is 30 June.
For an application form and information pack, contact
Phil Brown (Philip.J.Brown@ukc,ac,uk, 01227-823794)
or Byron Morgan, (B.J.T....@ukc.ac.uk, 01227-827612),
or see the URL,
http://www.ukc.ac.uk/IMS/statistics/resbook.html.
